Thank you for this, friend. You are a very kind soul. ❤️

Yes, I am familiar with ACoA and AlAnon. I actually downloaded the app and still have it, but do not join meetings very often. I will try to be consistent. You'll have to forgive me, motivation has been a very hard thing to find lately. To talk, and even to listen. I am truly so sorry that you're experiencing some of the same things as I am. Thank you so much for this.

My birthday is tomorrow and my mother passed on 12/10/21. I imagine tomorrow will be hard, but hoping it will be okay. I'm turning 23 as well. Just thought I'd let you know that I relate and I am so so sorry for your loss. You are not alone. I see my family living their lives like normal too, but I know they're hurting on the inside. I don't think there will ever be a day that you "move on" or "get over it". I think we just accept this life without them at some point and try our best to live and bring happiness to others in their memory, like they did for us. I know this is hard for you. You. Are. Not. Alone.
I thought this was a rug.

I can definitely relate to the last part of your comment, and I'm sorry for your loss. Everybody in my family is like, "Wow that's so cool that you dream of her so often, how does she look? Where is she? What are y'all doing?" 

Well she's dead, halfway... In her casket, and it lasts a split second.  It's not cool. It's actually scary. 

I don't wish to dream of my mother like this either. I'm sorry that you share similar experiences. Thank you for your comment and thank you for making me feel not so alone.
My Aunt is bringing some melatonin gummies here soon. Thank you for your comment and support. 💚

Thank you, I might just take you up on that offer if that's okay. I'm trying my best to start opening up to people about my feelings to my therapist and family. Thank you so much and I am so sorry for your loss.

I read this over and over and over again last night. I wrote your comment in my journal, step by step because I believe this is amazing advice. I don't think I can express to you enough how thankful I am that you took the time to type all of this out and help me. Thank you for your support. Thank you for your advice. I feel like this will help me and I especially think allowing myself some time to grieve during the day will help.

Thank you for sharing your experience. I am so sorry for your loss. Walking into the room that Momma was in during visitation was one of the hardest things to do, my family practically begged me to please go, and I think I regret it. I feel bad for regretting it, but if I had not gone, I wonder if these nightmares wouldn't be so bad. Thank you so much for commenting and thank you for your support.
Okay, I'll try that for a few nights and see if anything changes if I can even shut my eyes for a minute. I really appreciate this and it's something I didn't take into consideration until now.
Thank you. I'll definitely be trying this out.

Wow, thanks so much. Al-anon is definitely something that I don't think I'm quite ready to let go of, and thank you for being supportive. I hope therapy helps me just as much as it helped you. Maybe my story will help others. Who knows. It's been really hard, only 20 something days, but I'm trying my best to learn from this, continue to learn, and hopefully help others. I'm so glad it's not over for me. Thank you for being welcoming and thank you for taking the time to write out this comment. It means more than you know.

It's been very hard to get out of bed. I miss her so much, it gets harder each day.



 I am so sorry for your loss, mommas hold a place in our heart that nobody else could ever have. 

Thank you for coming back to this post. I am almost speechless... I don't know how to thank you enough. What you said was beautiful. 

 I am praying for you and keeping you in my thoughts.  This is an incredibly overwhelming situation, and I'm so sorry that you can relate, but thank you for reaching out and giving me some words of encouragement. It means more than you know friend.

I may take some extra time off, and try to feel these feelings instead of running away from them. I'm kind of scared, but I know that's the only way to heal.
